info.title: Lunar Landing Site Navigator service
info.description:
Deterministic Sun, Earth and terrain-horizon geometry for lunar landing replanning.

**Single trusted operator.** The agent endpoints start a model that writes and runs Python on this machine;
the service binds to loopback only and refuses other addresses unless explicitly allowed.

**Conventions.** Times are ISO-8601 UTC with `Z` suffix (internal: TDB seconds past J2000, field suffix
`_tdb_s`). Latitude/longitude are planetocentric, east-positive degrees in the mean-Earth/polar-axis frame.
The reference surface is a sphere of radius 1 737 400 m; heights are relative to it. Azimuth is degrees
clockwise from local north; elevation is degrees above the plane perpendicular to the Moon-centre radial
through the observer. Directions are apparent (light time and stellar aberration). Units are in field names
(`_deg`, `_m`, `_km`, `_s`, `_utc`). Errors are `application/problem+json`.

Lander attitude at rest.

Heading `yaw_deg` (body x, clockwise from north): `None` (the default) means the heading is **unknown**, as it is
for every lander before it lands. The engine then has no nominal heading: power is evaluated on
`UNKNOWN_HEADING_SAMPLES` evenly spaced headings over all 360 degrees and `yaw_uncertainty_deg` is ignored. A stated
heading is uncertain by `yaw_uncertainty_deg` either side and power is evaluated on `yaw_samples` evenly spaced
headings across that envelope (all 360 deg when the uncertainty is 180).

Constraints.title: Constraints
Constraints.description:
Constraint set of a scenario. Every constraint is optional (None = not applied).

Constraint semantics (value per landing epoch; see docs/validation/scenario.md):

- `landing_sun_elevation_deg`: apparent Sun-centre elevation above the local horizontal at landing.
- `landing_hours_after_sunrise`: hours since the array's last sunrise (flux > `sunlit_flux_fraction`).
- `dte_at_landing_deg`: direct-to-Earth clearance at landing, degrees above the antenna horizon plus
  `antenna_terrain_margin_deg` (best station of the network, or the Earth centre without a network).
- `min_sunlit_hours_after_landing`: continuous sunlit hours from landing.
- `max_dark_span_h`: longest dark span of the array during the surface mission.
- `min_total_sunlit_h`: total sunlit hours of the array during the surface mission (need not be continuous).
- `min_state_of_charge`: minimum battery state of charge (fraction) during the mission.
- `min_contact_fraction` / `max_contact_gap_h`: network contact fraction / longest outage.
- `min_total_contact_h`: total hours in contact during the mission (best station of the network, or the Earth
  centre above the antenna horizon without a network).
- `min_total_sunlit_contact_h`: total hours during the mission that are sunlit and in contact at the same time.
- `min_link_margin_db`: lowest downlink margin while in contact.
- `max_slope_deg`: terrain slope over `slope_baseline_m` (only with a provider that has terrain).

EclipseSettings.title: EclipseSettings
EclipseSettings.description:
Earth-shadow convention passed explicitly to `ephem.earth_eclipse_fraction`.

Default `"danjon"`: the Earth enlarged to 1.01 x its equatorial radius, the convention of the
NASA/GSFC eclipse contacts, which the engine reproduces within 4.6 s
(docs/validation/ephemeris.md section 6). `"geometric"` is the bare 6371 km sphere.

(clockwise from north). `dispersion="gaussian"`: the semi-axes are `sigma_level` sigmas of a
bivariate normal; `"uniform"`: points are uniformly distributed inside the ellipse.

holders.description: Clients that submitted this same request and have not cancelled; the job stops when the last one cancels (cancelling with others still holding only lets go).

cache_key.title: Cache Key
cache_key.description: SHA-256 of (kind, kind version, canonical request, data versions).

job_class.title: Job Class
job_class.description: `long` kinds (site search, regional layers) may hold at most `workers - 1` workers so a short analysis never waits behind them; queue order is first come, first served within a class.

queue.description: Why the job waits: set while it is queued and not yet handed to a worker, null otherwise. Re-sent as a `status` event whenever it changes.

JobStatus.title: JobStatus
JobStatus.description: Job record; also the payload of every ``status`` server-sent event.

coverage_utc.title: Coverage Utc
coverage_utc.description: First and last covered instant, UTC.

available.title: Available
available.description: False when the kernels could not be loaded (see `error`).

valid_utc.title: Valid Utc
valid_utc.description: Epoch range over which all kernels are valid.

LanderEntry.title: LanderEntry
LanderEntry.description: A lander constraint profile. Absent fields are unknown, not zero.

LanderProfile.title: LanderProfile
LanderProfile.description:
Lander geometry, power and communication parameters used by every analysis.

`array_height_m` and `antenna_height_m` are the two observer heights above local ground, so each
site has two horizons. `origins` maps a field path (e.g. ``"antenna_height_m"``,
``"battery.capacity_wh"``) to its provenance; fields without an entry are user inputs.

kind.title: Kind
kind.description: Source kind of the entry (`engine_result`, ...): what a number cited from it is attributed to.

size_bytes.title: Size Bytes
size_bytes.description: Size of the whole output as compact JSON.

rows.title: Rows
rows.description: Declared row lists: dotted path -> the key field of their rows.

row_ids.title: Row Ids
row_ids.description: The ids a `[L0006#id]` citation may name; a row nested in a row is `parent/child`.

output.title: Output
output.description: The whole output when it is at most `limit_bytes`; null otherwise (use `skeleton` and `row_id`).

skeleton.title: Skeleton
skeleton.description: Set when `output` is null: the output with every declared row list replaced by null; fetch rows with `row_id`.

row.title: Row
row.description: That row (a list: rows with the same id are merged, usually one); null without `row_id`.

LedgerResult.title: LedgerResult
LedgerResult.description: The full stored result of one ledger entry (what the agent's tool returned), hash-verified against the ledger.

stops.title: Stops
stops.description: Colour stops (linear interpolation in RGB) for `ramp` layers.

Limit.title: Limit
Limit.description:
One optional pass/fail constraint: `min <= value <= max` (either side optional).

`margin_scale` (in `unit`) normalises the signed margin when constraints of different units are
compared to name the limiting one: normalised margin = margin / margin_scale.

id.title: Id
id.description: Stable dotted lower-case id, one per concept and never reused (the registry is `lunarnav.report.limits`): key on this, not on `text` or `category`.

kind.title: Kind
kind.description: Machine-readable kind: group and highlight on this, never on `category`.

category.title: Category
category.description: Display heading of the note (what it is measured against, for a known miss). Text for people; its wording may change.

text.title: Text
text.description: The statement, with the measured numbers.

parameters.title: Parameters
parameters.description: The values `text` quotes, by name (e.g. `k_sigma`, `step_s`, `dem_id`, `pixel_m`), for a screen that formats its own sentence.

source.title: Source
source.description: Validation report and section, e.g. `imagery.md section 'What a planner can take from this', item 1`; the file is under `docs/validation/`.

quote.title: Quote
quote.description: Phrase copied from that report that supports `text`.

more.title: More
more.description: Further quoted phrases that carry the other numbers in `text`; empty when `quote` covers it.

LimitNote.title: LimitNote
LimitNote.description: A stated limit of the model that applies to this result, with the validation report it rests on.

LinkSpec.title: LinkSpec
LinkSpec.description:
Direct-to-Earth downlink budget inputs (see `visibility.link_budget`). The receive G/T comes from
each network station, or `default_g_over_t_dbk` when the station has none or no network is set.

LoadSpec.title: LoadSpec
LoadSpec.description: Bus load: `sunlit_w` while the array is sunlit (nominal horizon), `dark_w` otherwise (survival).

units.title: Units
units.description: Map units of the store grid (m polar, deg equirectangular).

margin_scale.title: Margin Scale
margin_scale.description: Size of the margin, in `unit`, that counts as 1.0 normalised.

service_version.title: Service Version
service_version.description: Version of the HTTP API contract (path prefix /api/v1).

agent_enabled.title: Agent Enabled
agent_enabled.description: Whether the agent endpoints are served (`LUNARNAV_API_AGENT_ENABLED`).

job_kinds.title: Job Kinds
job_kinds.description: Registered long-computation kinds and their version strings.

limits.title: Limits
limits.description: Named request limits enforced by the service (`lunarnav.api.limits`; the docs list what each bounds).

conventions.title: Conventions
conventions.description: Normative coordinate, time and unit conventions.

one_sided.title: One Sided
one_sided.description: The range is taken over the worlds that have the event only (the others have none in the analysed span).

when.title: When
when.description: When the extreme occurs, by horizon case (`nominal`, `optimistic`, `pessimistic`; null for a case with no instant, `nominal` null when the heading is unknown). Only the minimum-state-of-charge metric has it; `{}` for every other metric.

when_basis.title: When Basis
when_basis.description: How the instants in `when` are located and how exact they are; empty when `when` is empty.

when_resolution_s.title: When Resolution S
when_resolution_s.description: The signal-grid step the instants are interpolated from, seconds; null when `when` is empty.

et.title: Et
et.description: Ephemeris time (TDB seconds past J2000) of the extreme.

utc.title: Utc
utc.description: UTC of the extreme, whole seconds.

value.title: Value
value.description: The extreme's value in this case, beside its instant. `Metric.low` and `Metric.high` are the lowest and highest of the per-case values; with an unknown heading `low` is the pessimistic case's value and `high` the optimistic case's, and there is no nominal.

hold_s.title: Hold S
hold_s.description: How long the quantity stays at the extreme from that instant (0 for a single instant). Ties report the first instant.

Network.title: Network
Network.description:
Ground network. Empty means 'geometric direct-to-Earth': the Earth centre above the antenna
horizon plus margin, with no Earth-side mask.

`direction` selects the station mask that defines contact: `"downlink"` uses `rx_mask_deg`,
`"uplink"` uses `tx_mask_deg`, `"two_way"` uses the larger of the two.

NetworkStation.title: NetworkStation
NetworkStation.description: Earth ground station with receive (downlink) and transmit (uplink) elevation masks.

missing_worlds.title: Missing Worlds
missing_worlds.description: Worlds (`optimistic` / `pessimistic`) with no such event in the analysed span: `range_utc` is then taken over the other worlds only.

one_sided.title: One Sided
one_sided.description: `missing_worlds` is not empty: the true bound of the range lies beyond the data.

cause.title: Cause
cause.description: What set the event: `horizon`, `eclipse` (the Earth's shadow, Sun well above the horizon) or `horizon and eclipse`. `horizon` for contact events.

name.title: Name
name.description: The event named by its cause, to print: `sunset`/`sunrise`, `eclipse start`/`eclipse end`, `sunlight loss`/`sunlight return`, `loss of contact`/`acquisition of contact`.

duration_h.title: Duration H
duration_h.description: Hours from the first to the last open candidate (0 for a single candidate). The true edges lie within one `spacing_h` beyond either end, so the open interval can be up to `duration_h + 2 * spacing_h` long.

best_margin.title: Best Margin
best_margin.description: Dimensionless normalised margin: the signed margin of the limiting constraint divided by its `margin_scale` (a constraint property in its own unit; see `margin_scales`). 0 is on the limit, positive inside it, 1 is one scale unit of headroom; margins of constraints in different units are compared in this scale. It is the pessimistic-case margin of the limiting constraint (the nominal one only for a FAIL epoch), and null where the limiting quantity is undefined (for example the minimum state of charge at an unknown heading).

best_margin_physical.title: Best Margin Physical
best_margin_physical.description: The same margin in the unit of the limiting constraint (`best_margin_unit`): normalised margin x that constraint's `margin_scale`. Positive inside the limit. null when no constraint limits.

best_margin_note.title: Best Margin Note
best_margin_note.description: The engine's sentence for a `best_case` margin (no nominal: the heading is unknown), else null.

best_totals.title: Best Totals
best_totals.description: Nominal hours during the surface mission: `sunlit_h` (array sunlit), `contact_h` (in contact) and `sunlit_contact_h` (both at once), for a landing at `best_utc`.

Origin.title: Origin
Origin.description: Provenance of one value: its basis, a human label and (when researched) the opened source.

PanelSpec.title: PanelSpec
PanelSpec.description: Flat solar panel in the lander body frame (x forward, y left, z up; see `visibility.power`).

Parameter.title: Parameter
Parameter.description: A numeric setting (not pass/fail) with label, unit and origin.

data_offset.title: Data Offset
data_offset.description: Byte offset of the float32 heights (multiple of 4).

height_range_m.title: Height Range M
height_range_m.description: [min, max] of finite samples; null if all NaN.

effective_resolution_m.title: Effective Resolution M
effective_resolution_m.description: Finest store ground spacing actually sampled.

PatchHeader.title: PatchHeader
PatchHeader.description: JSON header of an LNP1 patch (also returned by `GET /terrain/patch/header`).

height_m.title: Height M
height_m.description: Metres above the 1737.4 km sphere; null where no store has data.

aspect_deg.title: Aspect Deg
aspect_deg.description: Downhill azimuth, degrees clockwise from north.

state.title: State
state.description: `warming` until every worker has loaded its kernels and compiled the numerical code.

seconds.title: Seconds
seconds.description: Wall time the warm-up took (when ready).

scenario_id.title: Scenario Id
scenario_id.description: Id of a stored scenario (`scen-` and 12 hex digits).

overrides.title: Overrides
overrides.description: JSON-merge-patch applied to the stored or inline document before validation: objects merge recursively, anything else replaces, `null` removes the key (use it to switch a constraint off). Example: `{"site": {"lat_deg": -89.5}, "landing_utc": "2028-03-01T00:00Z"}`.

terrain.title: Terrain
terrain.description: `on` uses the terrain stores (error if none are installed), `off` the smooth sphere, `auto` terrain when stores are installed and the sphere otherwise (the result's `provider` and `warnings` say which).

wait_s.title: Wait S
wait_s.description: Seconds to wait for the result before answering 202 with a job status.

distances_m.title: Distances M
distances_m.description: Shift distances, each above 0 and at most 25,000 m (a landing-dispersion study around the site; a larger move is another site: use `slip` alternatives or `search`). Default: the ellipse axes or 100, 500, 1000 m.

request_id.title: Request Id
request_id.description: Value of the X-Request-ID header of the response.

Problem.title: Problem
Problem.description: Error body of every non-2xx response (``application/problem+json``).

id.title: Id
id.description: Stable id: a catalogue lander id, `<lander>-polar`, or `generic-<layout>`.

variant.title: Variant
variant.description: `default` or `polar` for catalogue entries; the layout name for generic ones.

estimates.title: Estimates
estimates.description: Every origin that is not published or user-entered.

n_published.title: N Published
n_published.description: Number of fields whose origin is published.

path.title: Path
path.description: Field path inside the profile, e.g. `battery.capacity_wh`.

ProfileEstimate.title: ProfileEstimate
ProfileEstimate.description: A profile field whose value is not published: flag it in the UI.

layouts.title: Layouts
layouts.description: Layout names accepted for generic profiles.

Quantity.title: Quantity
Quantity.description:
One lander parameter with its provenance.

`basis` says whether the value is printed in the source (``published``), computed from
published values (``derived``), or an engineering estimate (``estimate``). `source` indexes
the entry's `sources` list.

position.title: Position
position.description: 1-based place among the queued jobs of its class (1 = next to start).

waiting_for.title: Waiting For
waiting_for.description: `worker`: every worker is busy. `long-limit`: a long job is held back because long jobs already use all the workers they may; a free worker stays for short jobs.

ahead_count.title: Ahead Count
ahead_count.description: Jobs that must finish or start first: the running jobs it waits for plus the queued jobs of its class before it.

ahead.title: Ahead
ahead.description: The first (at most 10) of them, running ones first, then queued ones in queue order.

QueueInfo.title: QueueInfo
QueueInfo.description: Where a queued job stands in its class and what it waits for.

worst_margin.title: Worst Margin
worst_margin.description: Dimensionless normalised margin: the signed margin of the limiting constraint divided by its `margin_scale` (a constraint property in its own unit; see `margin_scales`). 0 is on the limit, positive inside it, 1 is one scale unit of headroom; margins of constraints in different units are compared in this scale. It is the pessimistic-case margin of the limiting constraint (the nominal one only for a FAIL epoch), and null where the limiting quantity is undefined (for example the minimum state of charge at an unknown heading).

worst_margin_physical.title: Worst Margin Physical
worst_margin_physical.description: `worst_margin` x the limiting constraint's `margin_scale`, in `margin_unit`; null when no constraint limits.

margin_unit.title: Margin Unit
margin_unit.description: Unit of `worst_margin_physical` (that of the limiting constraint).

margin_kind.title: Margin Kind
margin_kind.description: `worst_case`, `nominal` (a failing point) or `best_case` (see `margin_note`); the engine's rule, `lunarnav.scenario.margin_kind`. Null without a margin.

margin_note.title: Margin Note
margin_note.description: The engine's sentence for a `best_case` margin (no nominal: the heading is unknown), else null.

totals.title: Totals
totals.description: Nominal hours during the surface mission: `sunlit_h` (array sunlit), `contact_h` (in contact) and `sunlit_contact_h` (both at once), for a landing at `landing_utc`.

coverage.title: Coverage
coverage.description: Share of the independent cells whose exact value lay inside the estimated [lo, hi] bracket.

cells.title: Cells
cells.description: Independent cells the measurement used (all areas together).

support.description: Null for a layer without a support record (the `verdict` layer).

point_value.title: Point Value
point_value.description: How the per-cell value may be read: `supported` (within its measured error), `approximate` (typical error small, tail large: show the bracket beside it), `bracket_only` (never show the value alone).

dem_ids.title: Dem Ids
dem_ids.description: Stores to use (default: all complete stores).

bounds.title: Bounds
bounds.description: Compute the estimated bracket layers `<layer>_lo` / `_hi` (calibrated for about 99 % coverage; they can miss the exact value).

calibrate.title: Calibrate
calibrate.description: Cells used to calibrate the horizon error against the exact engine.

limits.title: Limits
limits.description: Layer name -> limit; adds a `verdict` layer: 1 pass, -1 fail, 0 marginal, -128 no data.

inline.title: Inline
inline.description: Layers to return inline as 2-D arrays (row 0 north).

RegionalRequest.title: RegionalRequest
RegionalRequest.description:
Gridded illumination and Earth-visibility layers over a square region around a point (polar stereographic
grid of the LOLA products): average illumination, mean flux, longest sunlit / shadow / Earth outage, slope, with
pessimistic and optimistic bounds. Needs the terrain stores. A job of minutes to tens of minutes; the layers are
GeoTIFFs listed in the result (`GET /exports/files/{digest}/{name}`).

spec.title: Spec
spec.description: Grid: polar-stereographic origin (centre of cell row 0, col 0), size, spacing, period, rules.

files.title: Files
files.description: GeoTIFF per layer and `header.json` (method, calibration, timings).

layer_support.title: Layer Support
layer_support.description: Support record of every layer that has one (also in `header.layer_support` and in the GeoTIFF band tags).

point_value.title: Point Value
point_value.description: `supported` / `approximate`: the value may be shown with its measured error; `bracket_only`: never show the value alone, show [lo, hi] from `bracket_layers`; `exact_input`: an input of the computation; `bracket`: this layer is the low or high end of the estimated bracket of `bracket_of`.

unit.title: Unit
unit.description: Unit of the value: `fraction (0-1)` (not percentage points), hours, degrees, metres.

error_unit.title: Error Unit
error_unit.description: Unit of the errors: `percentage points` for fractions, `hours` for run lengths; null for an exact input.

bracket_layers.title: Bracket Layers
bracket_layers.description: The `<layer>_lo` / `<layer>_hi` layers that bracket this one (empty for exact inputs and for the bracket layers themselves).

run_measured_error.title: Run Measured Error
run_measured_error.description: Error of THIS run on its calibration cells, regional minus exact, in `error_unit` (`mean_signed`, `mean_abs`, `p95_abs`, `max_abs`, `n_cells`); null when the run did not calibrate (`calibrate` 0) or for an input / bracket layer.

run_measured_on.title: Run Measured On
run_measured_on.description: The configuration of this run's calibration; null with `run_measured_error`.

validation.description: Measurement at the reference configuration, with the measured bracket coverage; null for an exact input. The `_lo` / `_hi` records carry the base layer's. `applies_to_run` says whether this run uses that configuration.

bracket_of.title: Bracket Of
bracket_of.description: For a bracket layer: the layer it brackets.

bracket_low_horizon.title: Bracket Low Horizon
bracket_low_horizon.description: How the horizon is moved to make the `_lo` layer: `lowered` for a statistic that grows with the horizon (a run of shadow or outage is smallest there), `raised` for one that falls with it (illumination). Null for an exact input and for a bracket layer.

bracket_high_horizon.title: Bracket High Horizon
bracket_high_horizon.description: The other direction: how the horizon is moved to make the `_hi` layer.

horizon_shift.title: Horizon Shift
horizon_shift.description: For a bracket layer: the way its horizon is moved (`raised` or `lowered`).

RegionalSupport.title: RegionalSupport
RegionalSupport.description: What a layer's per-cell value can be relied on for (`lunarnav.regional.support`, measured in docs/validation/illumination.md).

configuration.title: Configuration
configuration.description: The reference configuration the measurement was made at.

applies_to_run.title: Applies To Run
applies_to_run.description: Whether this run uses that configuration (null when the run's is not known).

measured_error.title: Measured Error
measured_error.description: `unit`, `mean_signed`, `mean_abs`, `p95_abs`, `p99_abs`, `max_abs`: regional minus exact, in the layer's `error_unit`.

RegionalValidation.title: RegionalValidation
RegionalValidation.description: A measurement at the reference configuration (mast 0 m, default stack, any_part / any_part, 32 calibration cells).

document.title: Document
document.description: Where the measurement is described: file and section under `docs/`.

measured_by.title: Measured By
measured_by.description: Script, areas, cells per area, seed and how the cells were chosen (verbatim from the record).

configuration.title: Configuration
configuration.description: The configuration the measurement was made at (mast, rules, spacing, step, period, stores, calibration cells).

RegionalValidationRecord.title: RegionalValidationRecord
RegionalValidationRecord.description: The record the package ships (`lunarnav/regional/validation_reference.json`), served as it is so no client carries a copy.

generated_utc.description: The report's only time-dependent text. Give it for a byte-identical report; omitted, it is the time the report was computed (a cached report keeps its original time).

ReportRequest.title: ReportRequest
ReportRequest.description:
Body of `POST /report`: the scenario is always evaluated; `scan`, `slip`, `compare_with`, `ellipse` and `search`
add their sections. Each analysis is run inside the report job with the parameters of its own endpoint (its result
is not shared with a job of `/analyses/*`; a repeated report is served from the report's own cache). The slip
section is for the scenario's own site, so `slip` takes no alternatives; `ellipse` needs the scenario's `ellipse`.

prompt.title: Prompt
prompt.description: First user message of the run.

model.title: Model
model.description: Model id; default from the harness config.

budget_usd.title: Budget Usd

Above the service's ceiling (`LUNARNAV_API_AGENT_BUDGET_CEILING_USD`, 25 USD) it is a 422. Returned as `budget_usd` in the run status and kept across resumes.

state.title: State

prompt_template_sha256.title: Prompt Template Sha256

live.title: Live

sandbox.title: Sandbox
sandbox.description: Sandbox status from the latest run_start event.

SearchRequest.title: SearchRequest
SearchRequest.description:
Multi-level search of a region for sites satisfying the scenario's constraints: a cheap coarse pass prunes
the lattice, the full horizon runs on the promoted points, and the best sites are ranked. The scenario's own
site is ignored (the region defines where sites are). Minutes for a 5 km region at 20 m spacing: use a job.

TerrainErrorSettings.title: TerrainErrorSettings
TerrainErrorSettings.description:
DEM error budget widening the horizon bracket by `k_sigma` sigmas (see `visibility.uncertainty`).

Applied only when the horizon provider models terrain. `mode`:

* `"product"` (default): at every azimuth the budget of the product that supplies the height at the
  limiting blocker (`TerrainStack.error_at`; figures and citations in `terrain.sources.PRODUCT_ERRORS`).
  A product with no published figure carries the assumed global budget below, flagged `assumed`.
* `"custom"`: `sigma_z_m` and `sigma_xy_m` apply to every azimuth. Their defaults are the vertical accuracy of
  LOLA-based global products about 3-4 m (SLDEM2015) and geolocation under 10 m (Smith et al. 2017,
  Icarus 283, Appendix table and abstract; docs/research/literature.md section 4.1).

`sigma_z_m` / `sigma_xy_m` apply in `custom` mode only (in `product` mode they are reset to their defaults).

Transfer.title: Transfer
Transfer.description:
How a launch epoch maps to a landing epoch.

`kind="fixed"`: landing = launch + `duration_days`.
`kind="table"`: discrete launch opportunities from flight dynamics; a launch that is ready at L
takes the first row whose launch is at or after L (one cannot launch before being ready), and
lands at that row's landing epoch. Ready times after the last row have no landing.
